description: The plot illustrates how average performance varies with model size (parameter count) for three metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks. The x-axis is labeled “Model Size (log scale)” and uses a logarithmic scale with discrete tick labels at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis is labeled “Avg. Performance (%)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from 0 to 80%, with major tick labels shown at 20% intervals (20, 40, 60, 80). Three solid lines with upward-pointing triangle markers are shown: Precision is a red solid line that starts near 78% at 70m, declines to about 75% at 160m and about 70% at 410m, then rises gradually through roughly 72–73% around 1.0B–1.4B to about 74% at 2.8B and about 76–77% at 7.0B; Recall is a blue solid line that increases steadily from about 8% at 70m to about 11% at 160m, about 20% at 410m, about 26% at 1.0B, about 28% at 1.4B, about 35% at 2.8B, and about 45% at 7.0B; F1-score is a purple solid line that also increases across the x-axis, starting near 14% at 70m and rising to about 19% at 160m, about 31% at 410m, about 39% at 1.0B, about 41% at 1.4B, about 48% at 2.8B, and about 56% at 7.0B.
